subject: Penpot compatibility breakpoint 06 — after transport fix
body: The Penpot plugin is now visibly connected. Run the deterministic compatibility probe immediately against the current patched @penpot/mcp@2.13.3 runtime: first high_level_overview read-only, then export_shape for shapeId page format png. Preserve the complete raw return object or exception from each call. Do not mutate the design and do not use LLM planning.
